authorityBasis: Explicit project direction: migrate to the v4 successor architecture and preserve v3.3/v4 capabilities; retain old-app guarantees without preserving conflicting legacy mechanisms merely to reduce change.

developmentAuthority.currentOperationalApplication: remains operationally canonical until governed cutover
developmentAuthority.legacyApplicationRole: capability, security, data-continuity and migration baseline; not equal architectural authority
developmentAuthority.dataCutoverStrategy: clean cutover is preferred for development-only local/backend data; no site-truth data is asserted

nonNegotiableSuccessorCapabilities: discipline lanes including EMD, Refractory and SHARED

legacyTreatment.developmentDataDisposition: inventory first; then reset/reseed under v4 schema when separately authorised

mandatoryBeforeCutover: governed Firebase configuration restoration and exact-hash identity proof
authentic pinned Isar generation and inherited-ID continuity proof
pre-live backend export and rollback runbook
signing, App Check, recovery and controlled pilot authority

initialMigrationDataPolicy.requiredSafeguard: read-only inventory before any deletion; no production mutation under this artifact
initialMigrationDataPolicy.preferredInitialState: empty new workflow collections plus known-good synthetic seed data
